Thank you @WhereonEarth for this insightful 4K documentary exploring former East Germany! 🇩🇪 Exploring how history, culture, and architecture endure after 35 years—from Berlin's divided streetlights to Dresden and Leipzig—is truly fascinating. 🛰 The stunning visuals and deep historical context capture a unique legacy that time hasn't erased. 🗺 Brilliant work bringing this remarkable journey to life!
